_source: public.sh_accreditation_metrics, read live from production over PostgREST on 2026-08-01. 107 active rows, 10 awarding bodies.
_why_a_json_file: These are VERBATIM database values, not copy. Two of them ('Attribute 8: Student Outcomes', 'Welfare & Student Support', 'Attribute 2: Faculty Resources') contain terms the JKKN zero-tolerance terminology standard replaces in learner-facing prose. Rewriting them would make the fixture a lie about what the database holds, and the whole point of this fixture is that it is not a lie. Keeping them as data, in a data file, states plainly what they are — a row of a table nobody on this team wrote.
_regenerate: SELECT metric_type, category, count(*) FROM public.sh_accreditation_metrics WHERE is_active GROUP BY 1,2;
_the_trap: Attribute 9 and Attribute 10 each appear under TWO spellings. Grouping on the raw string yields 12 NAAC sections where the framework has 10.
